
## NASA POWER

[Exact request](https://power.larc.nasa.gov/api/temporal/daily/point?parameters=PRECTOTCORR%2CT2M%2CRH2M&community=AG&longitude=120.98493761&latitude=14.59932236&start=20150101&end=20231231&format=JSON&time-standard=LST); retrieved 2026-10-25T01:35:07.149Z; SHA256 485611dd0821bea0b575c5d278f8f810dd26285a21a9d8f059c4a973a32c8b45.
PRECTOTCORR mm/day, T2M Celsius, RH2M percent, MERRA-2 point estimates, meteorology grid 0.5 by 0.625 degrees. LST is a solar swath, not a civil timezone; this independent weekly cross-check has a boundary-time limitation. No per-city weather generated.
